BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) moves tokens from msg.sender
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) moves tokens using allowance
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) sets an allowance
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) adds to an allowance
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) reduces an allowance
MintableToken.mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) creates new tokens, onlyOwner and canMint
MintableToken.finishMinting() permanently disables minting, onlyOwner
BurnableToken.burn(uint256 _value) destroys tokens from msg.sender
ComplexChildToken.burn(uint256 _value) override gated by canBurn flag
Refundable.refundETH(address payee, uint256 amount) sends ETH to payee, onlyOwner
Refundable.refundERC20(address tokenContract, address payee, uint256 amount) calls external token transfer, onlyOwner
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) changes the owner, onlyOwner
Slogan.ownerChangeSlogan(string _slogan) updates the slogan, onlyOwner
